items.title: PHOTOS: Tight security in Maiduguri ahead of Tinubu’s campaign rally
items.summary: Maiduguri, the capital of Borno State, has been placed under tight security with major routes blocked ahead of President Bola Tinubu's visit for an All Progressives Congress presidential campaign rally. Security agencies including police, Army, and Civil Defence Corps have been deployed across critical routes, with residents advised to avoid non-essential movements and use alternative routes.
items.why: The heightened security measures reflect ongoing concerns about public safety during high-profile political events in a region previously affected by insurgency.

items.title: Adeleke pledges to prioritise welfare, infrastructure in second term
items.summary: Osun State Governor Ademola Adeleke has pledged to prioritise citizens' welfare, infrastructure development, and economic growth as he prepares for his second-term inauguration. Adeleke expressed gratitude to residents for their re-election support and acknowledged those who lost their lives during the 2026 governorship election.
items.why: Adeleke's commitments signal his administration's focus on consolidating gains and addressing infrastructure and economic challenges in his second term.

items.title: Nollywood legend Pete Edochie dies at 79
items.summary: Nollywood legend Pete Edochie has died at age 79 after a prolonged battle with prostate cancer. The veteran actor, best known for his iconic role as Okonkwo in the NTA adaptation of Chinua Achebe's 'Things Fall Apart', passed away on November 25, 2026, in Enugu.
items.why: Pete Edochie's death marks the loss of one of Nigeria's most celebrated cultural ambassadors and a defining figure in Nollywood's history.

items.title: Veteran actor, Pete Edochie, dies at 79
items.summary: Anambra State governor, Professor Chukwuma Soludo has expressed deep sadness over the death of veteran Nollywood actor Pete Edochie, describing his passing as a profound loss to his community, Nteje, Igbo people, Nigeria and Africa. items.title: Ronaldo deserves fitting farewell from Portugal, says Guardiola
items.summary: Pep Guardiola has called on the Portuguese Football Federation to give Cristiano Ronaldo a fitting farewell from the national team after his recent retirement from international football. Guardiola urged both sides to resolve their differences and organize a celebration where Ronaldo feels appreciated by Portuguese supporters.
items.why: Ronaldo's departure from international football after 23 years represents the end of an era for Portuguese football and raises questions about how legendary players should be honored.

items.title: FIFA Appoints Atilola Bashiru To NFF Normalisation Committee
items.summary: FIFA has appointed Atilola Shina Bashiru as an additional member of the Nigeria Football Federation Normalisation Committee, bringing total membership to six. Bashiru, an Executive Director at Premium Trust Bank, brings corporate and commercial expertise to strengthen NFF reforms.
items.why: The appointment reflects FIFA's effort to inject private-sector expertise into Nigerian football administration as part of ongoing governance reforms.

items.title: Ecobank announces exit of three directors
items.summary: Ecobank Transnational Incorporated has announced the departure of three members of its Board of Directors, including two who completed their terms and one who resigned.
items.why: Board changes at Ecobank, a major pan-African financial institution, signal potential shifts in corporate governance and strategic direction.

items.title: Kano distributes 484 tricycle ambulances to boost rural healthcare
items.summary: Kano State Governor Abba Kabir Yusuf has launched the One Ward, One Ambulance initiative by distributing 484 specially designed tricycle ambulances to all political wards across the state's 44 local government areas. The Abba Gida-Gida Rural Ambulance Service aims to improve emergency medical transportation access in rural communities for pregnant women, children, and accident victims.
items.why: This initiative addresses critical healthcare delivery gaps in rural areas by ensuring timely emergency medical transportation, potentially saving lives in underserved communities.

items.title: Puerto Rico’s Jennifer Barreto wins Miss Universe 2026
items.summary: Puerto Rico's Jennifer Barreto, a 27-year-old social worker, has won Miss Universe 2026, becoming the first married woman and mother to claim the title since the pageant lifted restrictions on such contestants. She defeated 115 other contestants at the 75th edition held in San Juan.
items.why: Barreto's victory marks a historic shift in beauty pageant standards and represents a significant win for Puerto Rico, which now has six Miss Universe titles.

items.title: Pete Edochie’s most memorable proverbs, quotes
items.summary: PUNCH Online has compiled Pete Edochie's most memorable proverbs and quotes that made him famous as the 'King of Proverbs' in Nigerian popular culture. The collection includes traditional African wisdom, particularly Igbo proverbs, that he popularised through his performances and public appearances, covering themes of caution, humility, wisdom, and human nature.
items.why: Edochie's proverbs and quotes represent a significant cultural legacy that continues to influence Nigerian society and demonstrate the power of traditional wisdom in modern contexts.

items.title: “We’ve lost a titan, legend, an icon,” Gov Mbah mourns Pete Edochie
items.summary: Governor Peter Mbah of Enugu State has mourned the death of veteran Nollywood actor Pete Edochie, aged 79, describing him as a titan, legend, and icon who brought Nigerian culture and values to global audiences. Mbah noted that Edochie's passing is particularly poignant as it coincides with Enugu hosting the National Festival of Arts and Culture, and highlighted the actor's role in preserving and promoting Igbo cultural heritage through his craft.
items.why: Pete Edochie's death marks the loss of one of Africa's most influential cultural ambassadors whose legacy shaped Nigerian cinema and global perceptions of African culture.

items.title: FG, Soludo, Nollywood stars mourn Pete Edochie
items.summary: The Federal Government, Anambra State Governor Chukwuma Soludo, and Nollywood stars have paid tributes to Pete Edochie following his death at age 79. The Federal Ministry of Art, Culture, Tourism and the Creative Economy described his contributions to Nigerian theatre and film as unforgettable, while Soludo called him an institution and distinguished custodian of culture.
items.why: The widespread tributes underscore Pete Edochie's profound impact on Nigerian culture, cinema, and national identity across multiple sectors of society.

items.title: ‘You were an institution’, May Edochie mourns Pete Edochie
items.summary: Nollywood actress May Edochie has paid tribute to veteran actor Pete Edochie, describing him as an institution whose contributions to the Nigerian film industry would remain unforgettable. She reflected on his resilience through years of false death rumours and praised his enduring legacy as a father figure and cultural ambassador.
items.why: May Edochie's tribute highlights the personal and professional impact Pete Edochie had on younger generations of Nigerian actors and the entertainment industry.

items.title: Two children, four others die in US plane crash
items.summary: Six people, including two children aged eight and 10, have died after a Cessna 210 aircraft crashed into the Gulf of Mexico off Mississippi while travelling from New Orleans to Fort Myers. The US Coast Guard recovered all bodies from the aircraft's fuselage after an extensive search and rescue operation.
items.why: The crash highlights aviation safety concerns and the tragic loss of lives, with the recovery operation demonstrating international maritime rescue coordination efforts.

items.title: PHOTOS: Army commander decorates promoted soldiers in Abuja
items.summary: Brigadier General Innocent Enwuchola, commander of the Nigerian Army Medical Corps, has decorated newly promoted soldiers with their new ranks in Abuja. The commander charged the promoted personnel to demonstrate humility, discipline, and greater responsibility, commending their hard work and commitment during the Corps' relocation from Lagos to Abuja.
items.why: The promotion ceremony recognises military personnel's dedication and contributions while emphasising the importance of maintaining professional standards and ethical conduct at higher ranks.
